cards.title: Taking a file back out
cards.body: Staged something by mistake? `git restore --staged <file>` takes it out of the staging area. The file itself stays as it is.
cards.code:
git init
touch index.html secret.txt
git add .
git restore --staged secret.txt
git status

hi.title: File ko wapas bahar nikalna
hi.body: Galti se kuch stage ho gaya? `git restore --staged <file>` use staging area se bahar nikal deta hai. File khud waisi hi rehti hai.

cards.title: Keep secrets out
cards.body: Passwords and keys must never be committed: once a commit is shared, everyone can read it, forever.

hi.title: Secrets bahar rakho
hi.body: Passwords aur keys kabhi commit nahi hone chahiye: commit share hote hi sab use padh sakte hain, hamesha ke liye.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: This should take `secret.txt` back out of staging, but it does not. Tap the bug.
cards.code:
git init
touch index.html secret.txt
git add .
git restore secret.txt
git status

bug.fix: To unstage a file, add `--staged`: `git restore --staged secret.txt`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse `secret.txt` ko staging se wapas bahar nikalna chahiye, par aisa nahi hota. Bug par tap karo.
hi.fix: File unstage karne ke liye `--staged` jodo: `git restore --staged secret.txt`.

check.question: What does `git restore --staged secret.txt` do?
options: Takes secret.txt out of the staging area
check.explanation: It only unstages the file. The file and its contents are untouched.

hi.question: `git restore --staged secret.txt` kya karta hai?
options: secret.txt ko staging area se bahar nikalta hai
hi.explanation: Yeh sirf file ko unstage karta hai. File aur uska content waise hi rehte hain.

exercise.prompt: Both files are staged, but `passwords.txt` must not be committed. Unstage it, then commit `index.html` with the message `Add home page`.
exercise.promptHi: Dono files staged hain, par `passwords.txt` commit nahi honi chahiye. Use unstage karo, phir `index.html` ko message `Add home page` ke saath commit karo.

checks.label: A commit says `Add home page`
checks.labelHi: Ek commit `Add home page` kehta hai
